name: Stirling American Strawberry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: As special as picking fresh strawberries, Stirling Strawberry Syrup has real strawberry fruit concentrate and true, pure strawberry flavor, with a sweet fragrance. Strawberries are very high in Vitamin A and C.

name: Stirling Asian Rose Cane Sugar Syrup
description: As delicate as the flower itself, Stirling Rose Syrup will flavor your favorite beverage without overwhelming you.  Perfect for flavoring teas, you can also use Stirling Rose Syrup to make rose water for baking or to flavor a martini.

name: Stirling B-52 Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Bombastic blend of orange liqueur, coffee liqueur and Irish cream.  Stirling B-52 Syrup flies through all three flavors in succession, for a truly unique syrup patterned after the popular cocktail.

name: Stirling Big Apple Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Our Stirling Big Apple syrup brings the bright and amazing taste of Washington Red apples. We the doctor recommends an apple a day, we recommend adding this to your morning tea or to an afternoon Italian Soda.

name: Stirling Blue Curacao Cane Sugar Syrup
description: While Curacao is not naturally blue, our non-alcoholic version will leave you anything but. We recommend using this in mock-tails, or alcohol-free cocktails, or just mixing with your favorite citrus soda.

name: Stirling Blue Raspberry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Transform your drinks into pleasant surprises with Stirling Blue Raspberry syrup. Our Bright Juicy Raspberry flavor will delight the taste buds, while the the electric blue color dazzles kids and adults alike.

name: Stirling Bubble Gum Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The classic taste you remember from your childhood, our Bubble Gum syrup is perfect for your summer Italian sodas, or blend with vanilla ice cream for an amazing bubble gum milkshake!

name: Stirling California Almond Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Almonds have been cultivated in the Mediterranean for over 2000 years. Stirling Almond Syrup brings the rich and bold flavor of almonds to life. Try the sugar free version of this staple nut flavor!

name: Stirling Ceylon Cinnamon Cane Sugar Syrup
description: An amazingly versatile spice, our cinnamon syrup has many different uses. Use with many of our other amazing syrups, in your morning tea, or in many other hot or cold drinks. The big cinnamon taste will be sure to please the biggest of cinnamon fans.

name: Stirling Cherry Blossom Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Enjoy the rich flavors of Stirling’s Cherry Blossom Syrup. The delicate notes of wild cherry with floral and almond undertones makes this syrup perfect for spring, use in cocktails, lemonades, sodas, lattes and more.

name: Stirling Cherry Lime Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The flavors of Stirling’s Cherry Lime Syrup Harkens back to memories of childhood and classic cherry limeades. Combining the bright tastes of sweet maraschino cherries and zesty summer limes This Syrups is perfect for sodas, cocktails, lemonades, and more.

name: Stirling Cinnamon & Brown Sugar Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Stirling’s Cinnamon & Brown Sugar Syrup add uses the classic combination to add a little spice to your favorite beverage. Bring warmth to your morning Latte and add a sweet, smooth spice to ciders, Teas, and cocktails.

name: Stirling Classic Creme Brulee Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A caramel and vanilla custard flavor, enhanced by the notes of caramelized sugar, you can almost see the crackling crust of this favorite dessert flavoring.

name: Stirling Classic Vanilla Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Stirling Classic Vanilla Syrup is lighter and sweeter than the Stirling French Vanilla Syrup.  Each sip yields a sweet, smooth and creamy flavor that lingers long after the drink is finished.

name: Stirling Coffee Royale Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Our Coffee Royale syrup has all the flavor of your favorite drink without the alcohol, so it can be enjoyed in the morning worry free.

name: Stirling Creme Caramel Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Rich and buttery, caramel is popular the world over. Formulated specifically for specialty coffee drinks, Stirling Caramel Syrup delivers consistent and creamy caramel taste in every sip.

name: Stirling Creme de Cacao Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The original Crème de Cacao is a chocolate flavored liqueur with a hint of vanilla.  Stirling Crème de Cacao Syrup builds on that recipe, using dark chocolate and Bourbon vanilla.

name: Stirling Curacao Orange Cane Sugar Syrup
description: With a 4,000-year-old history, oranges are best known for their medicinal properties.  Stirling Curacao Orange Syrup captures that element, delivering a clean, aromatic and citrus flavor.  Use to flavor any drink needing a citrus note, or create the perfect orange creamscicle.

name: Stirling Egg-cellent Eggnog Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Eggnog is a staple around the holidays, and Stirling Egg-cellent Eggnog delivers on the eggy, creamy goodness you grew up with. Mix with whole milk and coffee for a festive morning latte.

name: Stirling English Red Raspberry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Especially popular in the Northwest, Raspberries, like their cousin blackberries, are most distinguished by their deep, red color. Stirling Raspberry Syrup contains fresh raspberry concentrate for a pure raspberry taste.

name: Stirling French Vanilla Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Hands-down, the Best French Vanilla in the market. Enjoyed by everyone, Stirling French Vanilla has a rich, bold, less sweet flavor distinguishing it from its counterpart, Classic Vanilla.

name: Stirling Georgia Peach Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Originally discovered in China, and then brought to the Mediterranean over 2500 years ago, peaches are a delectable fruit with a rich, ripe flavor.  Stirling Peach Syrup is made with real peach concentrate, which allows you taste the delicate flavor and robust aroma.

name: Stirling German Chocolate Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Rich and creamy, chocolate is ambrosia. Made with real, premium cocoa powder, Stirling German Chocolate Syrup is unlike any flavored syrup you’ll taste.

name: Stirling Gingerbread Cane Sugar Syrup
description: You can totally catch this syrup all year round. Our gingerbread syrup goes great in your morning coffee. Top off with our amazing Cinnamon shakable topping for a perfect holiday latte.

name: Stirling Going Bananas Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Originally from the Malaysian jungles of South Asia, bananas are quite possibly the world’s oldest fruit.  With hundreds of varieties worldwide, Stirling Banana Syrup tastes like a perfectly ripe banana.  Make sure to try the Banana Flambé recipe.  It's outstanding!

name: Stirling Granny's Snickerdoodle Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A decadent sugar cookie, with cinnamon and the slightest hint of lemon, Stirling Snickerdoodle Syrup will remind you of the treats from your grandmother’s kitchen.

name: Stirling Great Pumpkin Spice Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The sweetness of the fall season is combined in Stirling’s Great Pumpkin Spice Syrup. Combining the best of cinnamon, nutmeg and other delectable spices, you’ll enjoy a drink that will make you want the season to last all year long!

name: Stirling Green Apple Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Sour Apple flavored syrup is a staple for anyone making Italian sodas over the summer. The perfect mix of tart and sweet, just like eating a Granny Smith apple!

name: Stirling Green Mint Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The ultimate menthe flavor.  Stirling Green Mint Syrup combines the strong flavor and aroma of peppermint in a potent, dark green syrup.

name: Stirling Harvey's Butter Rum Batter Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Since 1952, Harvey’s® Butter Rum Batter has been providing a specialty mix for making delicious drinks. Their batter is made batch-by-batch, using real butter and other premium ingredients that give it the quality and unforgettable flavor their fans know and love. Stirling Flavors continues the same tradition of small batch processing and exceptional taste. Stirling’s love for all tastes delicious led us to create a flavored syrup that will be the star attraction during the upcoming holidays and cold winter months.

name: Stirling Hawaiian Coconut Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Grown in Europe, Asia, the Americas and Australasia, coconuts are warm weather fruits. Stirling’s Coconut Syrup harvests the rich, meaty coconut essence creating a flavor that is strong, bold and dominant.

name: Stirling Highland Butterscotch Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The heady flavors of cream, brown sugar, rich butter, pure sugar and vanilla combine to make Stirling Butterscotch Syrup popular among the young at heart.

name: Stirling Himalayan Pommegranate Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Pomegranate, a fruit valued in history for its health benefits, is another of our amazing flavors. Use in Italian sodas or mix with your favorite white wine and sparkling water for a summer time spritzer.

name: Stirling Homestyle Peanut Butter Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Like the childhood classic, our Homestyle Peanut Butter brings back memories of summers afternoons and school lunches. We recommend using this syrup with strawberry ice cream for a classic PB&J milkshake.

name: Stirling Irish Cream Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Created in 1952 in San Francisco, Irish Coffee because an overnight sensation. Stirling Irish Crème Syrup combines the heady balance of Irish Whiskey, coffee and whipped cream in our popular, non-alcoholic tribute to the original drink.

name: Stirling Italian Amaretto Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Originally a liqueur from Saronno, Italia, Amaretto is typically enjoyed straight, on the rocks or as a mixer.  Stirling Amaretto Syrup has a close flavor profile to Stirling Almond Syrup, with a liqueur taste.

name: Stirling Jamaican Rum Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A house favorite… Enjoyed all over the Caribbean, and the World, Stirling Jamaican Rum Syrup gives the flavor of non-alcoholic rum, with a hint of caramel for a smooth, rich taste. Use in Lattes, Non-Alcoholic Beverages and in Baking.

name: Stirling Lavender de Provence Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Lavender is embraced for its calming, soothing properties. Stirling Lavender de Provence Syrup give you the Natural aroma of lavender flower, and adds a semi-sweet herbal and floral flavor perfect for cocktails, lemonades, sodas, and more

name: Stirling Lemon Meringue Cane Sugar Syrup
description: The sharp, tangy, slightly sweet bite of lemon meringue pie is brought to life in Stirling Lemon Meringue Syrup.  Perfect for Italian Sodas.  For less citrus, add some cream.

name: Stirling Macadamia Nut Cane Sugar Syrup
description: From the Land Down Under, this native Australian white nut was brought to Hawaii in 1882. Today, Stirling’s Macadamia Nut Syrup brings you the delicate and robust flavor and unique aroma of these fascinating nuts.

name: Stirling Maraschino Cherry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Maraschino cherries are renowned for their ruby red color and tangy taste.  Stirling Maraschino Cherry Syrup delicately blends true cherry flavors for a fruit flavor profile, not candy tasting.

name: Stirling Mexican Kahlua Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Stirling Mexican Kahlua Syrup contains all the elements of the classic liquor without the alcohol! Enjoy with your morning cup of coffee, or with some steamed whole milk.

name: Stirling Mojito Mojo Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Our Mojito Mint syrup has the all the flavor of your favorite cocktail, without any of the alcohol. We recommend using this syrup with sparkling water for an afternoon treat.

name: Stirling Napoleon Brandy Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Stirling Mexican Kahlua Syrup contains all the elements of the classic liquor without the alcohol! Enjoy with your morning cup of coffee, or with some steamed whole milk.

name: Stirling New England Black Cherry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Dark and sweet, reminiscent of Bing Cherries, this is a perfect alternative to Maraschino cherry for Italian sodas, milkshakes, or baking.

name: Stirling New Zealand Kiwi Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Native to Northern China, Korea and Siberia, Kiwi is uniquely identified by its rich green color and black seeds.  Stirling Kiwi Syrup delivers the gentle flavor and sharp aroma of a kiwifruit.  Contains Kiwi juice for true flavor.

name: Stirling Old Fashioned Sarsaparilla Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Remember the old soda fountain?  Well, now you can take a trip down memory lane.  Stirling Sarsaparilla Syrup is so authentic, it makes a perfect Root Beer Float.  Add a splash of Stirling Cherry Syrup for a reminder of the Wild, Wild West.

name: Stirling Oregon Mountain Blackberry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A native berry of the Pacific Northwest, Stirling Blackberry Syrup combines the flavor of true blackberry concentrate and natural blackberry flavor to create the most satisfying blackberry syrup in the market.

name: Stirling Peppermint Schnapps Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A deliciously sweet, minty flavor that differs from its other mint counterparts. Stirling Peppermint Schnapps will make you think you are imbibing a digestif served in the Alps.

name: Stirling Persian Lime Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A member of the citrus family of fruits, Stirling Lime Syrup delivers the perfect Italian Soda. With a mix a tart and sweet, we're sure it will fly right off your shelves!

name: Stirling Polynesian Pineapple Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Our Pineapple syrup delivers the richness of the real thing, without the mess usually associated with cutting a Pineapple. Use in Italian sodas or with your favorite sparkling white wine for a tropical treat.

name: Stirling Rhythm & Blueberry Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Listen to the rhythm of the falling blueberries all year round!  Blueberries are considered beneficial antioxidants, and Stirling Blueberry Syrup uses real blueberries in every bottle.

name: Stirling Rocky Mountain Hazelnut Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Hazelnuts were revered as potent fertility food. Our Stirling Hazelnut Syrup is a strong, potent tribute to the great nut. We recommend using this in your morning latte.

name: Stirling Royal English Toffee Cane Sugar Syrup
description: “God Save the Queen.” This immensely popular flavor originated in England in the mid-19th century. Stirling English Toffee Syrup tastes like it’s made with treacle, butter and a hint of Vanilla.

name: Stirling Salted Caramel Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Stirling Salted Caramel Syrup combines the creamy indulgence of caramel with a contrasting salty bite, making it complex, versatile and addictive.

name: Stirling Sweet African Watermelon Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Everyone's favorite summer melon in syrup form! Our Watermelon syrup is just the right amount of sweet. Use for Italian sodas, or mix with vanilla ice cream for an amazing milk shake!

name: Stirling Sweetness Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Providing over 60 exceptionally high-quality gourmet flavors, Stirling syrups have won every award for quality and taste. rich and vibrant flavor is the result of using pure fruit juice concentrates and the finest flavor ingredients available.

name: Stirling Swiss Chocolate Almond Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A savory mix of two popular flavors.  The rich chocolate flavor is evenly rounded out by the almond notes, resulting in a blend perfect for your favorite hot or cold beverage.

name: Stirling Toasted Marshmallow Cane Sugar Syrup
description: A campfire favorite, Stirling Toasted Marshmallow Syrup continues the tradition of puffed sugar on a stick.  Perfect for your next Some Mores Latte!

name: Stirling Tropical Mango Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Mangoes are the epitome of tropical fruit. Sweet and delicious, our mango syrup is perfect for an evening cocktail or your favorite tropical punch.

name: Stirling Tuscan Tiramisu Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Just like your favorite Italian dessert, Stirling Tuscan Tiramisu Syrup will give your coffee that classic taste you know and love! This makes a great addition to your morning coffee or just steamed with whole milk for an evening treat.

name: Stirling Vienna Chocolate Mint Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Reminiscent of your favorite after dinner treat, Stirling Vienna Chocolate Mint is the perfect balance of sweet milk chocolate and cooling mint flavors.  Imagine yourself in Vienna eating chocolate mint cake and listening to Mozart!

name: Stirling White Chocolate Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Made from cocoa butter, milk, sugar and vanilla, White Chocolate is not really chocolate. However, Stirling White Chocolate Syrup incorporates the rich, creamy, vanilla note of a true white chocolate made from cocoa plants. It’s creamy and delicious!

name: Stirling White Peach Cane Sugar Syrup
description: White peaches have a softer peach flavor then their yellow counterparts, but are much more floral tasting The Delicate, Sweet, non-acidic, flavor of Stirling’s White Peach Syrup is great for Cocktails, teas, smoothies, lemonades, and more.

name: Stirling Yellow Passionfruit Cane Sugar Syrup
description: Did you know that Passion fruit is actually a berry? We didn't either until we started making our Passion Fruit syrup. This goes great in your coffee, but will also make an amazing Italian soda or milk shake.

name: Stirling Cherry Blossom Frappe Mixe
description: Like snow giving way to blooms Enjoy the color Transformation from white to Pink with Stirling’s Cherry Blossom Frappe Mix delivering Delicate floral notes of Cherry blossom with hints of vanilla.

name: Stirling Chocolate Cherry Blossom Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling’s Chocolate Cherry Blossom Frappe mix is espresso free & combines the delicate floral flavor of Cherry Blossom, with delicious rich cocoa in perfect harmony for the perfect spring dessert.

name: Stirling Chocolate (without Espresso) Frappe Mixe
description: NON-ESPRESSO – Stirling’s Chocolate Frappe mix is espresso free and made from delicious rich cocoa. This frappe is amazing on its own or can be used with Stirling Syrups and sauces to create your unique twist on classic frappes.

name: Stirling Cookies and Cream Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling Cookies and Cream Frappe mix is rich and velvety, with a classic taste that will put a smile on your face. While Great alone, Stirling Cookies and Cream Frappe mix can also be mixed with fruit, candy, cereal pieces, or one of our Gourmet Syrups and sauces. Let your creativity run wild.

name: Stirling English Toffee Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling’s English Toffee Frappé Mix is a decadent, rich mix with notes of chocolate, espresso, caramel, vanilla and brown sugar.  With little toffee bits, it blends up thick and sweet.  Add your favorite liqueur flavor for an added twist.

name: Stirling Mocha Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling’s Mocha Frappe mix is and artfully blended mix of rich cocoa and espresso and one of our best-selling products. This frappe is amazing on its own or can be used with Stirling Syrups and sauces to create your unique twist on mochas frappes.

name: Stirling Red Velvet Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling Red Velvet Frappe mix evokes the taste of the traditional dessert. Make a smooth creamy Frappe with flavors of rich chocolate, creamy vanilla and just a hint of cream cheese. You can also pair the frappé with a Stirling Syrup and/or Sauces and create a uniquely delicious frappés.

name: Stirling Vanilla Neutral Base Frappe Mixe
description: Stirling Vanilla Frappé Mix is a creamy vanilla base that can be made with or without any flavorings.  Pair the frappé with any Stirling Gourmet Syrup or Sauce and create perfect frappés every time.

name: Stirling Caramel Sauce Gourmet Sauce
description: Stirling’s Caramel Sauce adds a rich and intense flavor when used as an ingredient or topping. Perfect for coffee drinks, milkshakes, dessert toppings, or rimming cocktail glasses.

name: Stirling Chocolate Sauce Gourmet Sauce
description: Stirling's Gourmet Chocolate Sauce is creamy and rich.  It has a pourable consistency and pumps easily.  It blends perfectly with light and medium roast coffees and makes exceptional mochas, iced coffees and frappés.

name: Stirling Dark Chocolate Sauce Gourmet Sauce
description: Stirling's Dark Chocolate Sauce is decadent and bold.  It is thick and rich, yet pump-able.  It has a high percentage of cocoa and chocolate making it as pure to melted chocolate as you can get.  Make sure to stir well when using in hot drinks.  Pour a small amount of hot, steamed milk and melt the chocolate sauce before adding the rest of ingredients to your drink.

name: Stirling Pumpkin Spice Sauce Gourmet Sauce
description: You asked, we listened!  Stirling's Great Pumpkin Spice Sauce is out of this world delicious.  Use it in lattes, cappuccinos and frappés.  You won't be disappointed with the creamy texture, bold flavors and smooth finish.  It really is the best pumpkin spice sauce available.

name: Stirling Salted Caramel Gourmet Sauce
description: Made from the highest quality ingredients, Stirling Salted Caramel Sauce has a delectably sweet, richly intense flavor with a pop of salty. Perfect for coffee drinks, milkshakes, dessert toppings, or rimming cocktail glasses.

name: Stirling White Chocolate Sauce Gourmet Sauce
description: Stirling White Chocolate Sauce is a creamy, chocolatey sauce that's great for a white mocha, frappés and ice cream!  It is based on Stirling's White Chocolate Syrup so it imparts a great flavor with added body, cream and texture.

name: Stirling Chocolate Shakable Topping
description: Made with a rich, full-bodied cocoa, Stirling Chocolate Shakable Topping is the perfect way to add a deep chocolate flavor to fresh fruits, baked goods, and hot beverages.

name: Stirling Cinnamon Shakable Topping
description: Perfect rimming a glass, garnishing a drink, or topping a dessert; Stirling Cinnamon Shakable topping turns ordinary beverages into gourmet treats.

name: Stirling Mini Marshmallow Shakable Topping
description: Stirling Mini-Marshmallow bits turn ordinary beverages into gourmet treats whether topping off a steaming mug of hot chocolate, or adding them to one of your favorite cereals.

name: Stirling Peppermint Bits Shakable Topping
description: Stirling’s Peppermint Bits Shakable Topping is the perfect seasonal topping, adding the classic candy cane flavor & colors when sprinkled on your Lattes, Mochas, Cocoas, Brownies & Cookies. Tis the Season for peppermint!

name: Stirling Raspberry Shakable Topping
description: Whether rimming a glass, garnishing a drink, or topping a dessert Stirling Raspberry Shakable topping adds a subtly fruity aromas and flavors to your favorite beverages or gourmet treat.

description: Stirling's Sugar-Free Flavors are rich and concentrated, making them one of the most concentrated flavoring syrups on the market, saving you money on every pour. name: Stirling Blackberry Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Blackberry Tea Concentrate is a unique creation.  Made with plump, sweet blackberries from the Pacific Northwest, and combined with premium black tea, this tea is one of our personal favorites.  Try it with ice cream to make a wonderful Blackberry Tea Shake.

name: Stirling Lemon Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Lemon Tea Concentrate delicately blends premium black tea and fruit juices for a classic favorite. Served hot, blended, or over ice, each drink gives you the perfect balance of sweet and sour.

name: Stirling Mango Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Mango Tea Concentrate is a fruity blend of ripe, red mango fruit concentrate and premium black tea.   Not too sweet, nor too fruity, this flavor has become a favorite around the world. Try it iced or hot or as a mango Tea Smoothie.

name: Stirling Peach Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Peach Tea Concentrate is our #1 selling flavor because of its rich blend of yellow peaches and premium black tea. The tea is combined with fresh peach concentrate to produce a fruit tea that has a wonderful fresh fruit taste reminiscent of the days of Rhett Butler and Scarlet O’Hare.  Serve it iced or hot with a sprig of mint.  It’s a perfect tea to use for the south’s favorite, “Sweet Tea”.

name: Stirling Raspberry Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Raspberry Tea Concentrate is a delightful combination of ripe, rich raspberries balanced with premium black tea for a fruity tea, with black tea notes. Try Stirling's Raspberry Tea with sparkling water to make a terrific sparkling iced tea. On those extra hot days, treat everyone to Raspberry Smoothies.

name: Stirling Strawberry Tea Concentrate
description: Stirling Strawberry Tea Concentrate takes freshly picked strawberries and combines them with premium black tea for a refreshing tea drink.  Try Stirling's Strawberry Tea iced or sparkling and for a creamy note, add a little half and half, or whipped cream.
